ul.li: Generates a random sequence of digits (0 to 9) of the requested length when it is created.
Holds the target sequence as a string.
Decides whether a guess matches the target (matches).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 741px; height: 1px; padding-top: 103px; margin-left: 789px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

ul.li: Owns the log of all attempts made during the current app session (session persistence only, no database).
Builds an Attempt from a sequence and the player's guess and adds it to the log (record, addAttempt).
Computes the summary statistics: total attempts, correct attempts and accuracy percentage.
Exposes the log as a read-only list. The internal list is private, so other classes cannot change it directly.

div.p: Uses mutableStateListOf so Compose can observe changes. The public attempts getter returns a copy of the list.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 357px; margin-left: 732px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

ul.li: Immutable record of one completed attempt.
Stores the sequence length, the player's guess, the target sequence, whether the guess was correct, and the timestamp.
Holds data only, with no game logic. GameSession creates it, and the log and summary screens read from it.
